svg.title: Sharp-looking turns from one smooth equation
svg.desc: A numerically integrated trajectory in a two dimensional autonomous vector field. The path has irregular tight bends. This finite plot does not establish absence of all patterns. Equations are provided below the plot.

g.text: Sharp-looking turns from one smooth equation
Small arrows: vector field. Orange: a path following it. Both axes use the same scale.
No explicit pieces or random input. A finite view, not a claim of no mathematical structure.
a = sin(x + 2 sin(y)) + sin(√2 y + sin(x))
b = cos(√3 x − y) + sin(x + √2 y)
θ = 1.7 tanh(45 a) + 1.1 tanh(45 b) + 0.5 sin(x − y)

svg.text: The turns are very tight, but still rounded. A simple deterministic rule can look irregular.
